_comment: Demo catalogue for the fictional store 'Utsav House'. Every image is AI-generated (YouCam AI Image Generator V2, NanoGPT fallback) and labelled as such. base_inr is the India price; other markets get their own rounded price list at seed time. wear: women | men | any.
